minor_findings.summary: The S2 eval-2 repaired canonical artifact's source_ledger.published_at values are partial dates (year-only e.g. "2010" or year-month e.g. "2022-04"), which fail the stage schema's format:"date" annotation under strict (opt-in) FormatChecker; the handoff envelope and grading are unaffected.
minor_findings.failure_scenario: Draft202012Validator with FormatChecker yields 34+ errors '"2010"/"2022-04" is not a date' at content.source_ledger[].published_at; Draft202012Validator without FormatChecker yields 0 errors; S2 eval-1 (result.json) and example.md both use full YYYY-MM-DD dates and pass strict. Net: non-blocking annotation/data consistency gap isolated to one repaired canonical artifact; the operative inter-stage contract (handoff envelope) validates clean and grades 6/6.
minor_findings.required_change: Either relax the published_at format to allow year/year-month precision, or normalize the S2 eval-2 fixture's published_at to full dates so it matches the schema annotation under the project's own strict-FormatChecker standard.

minor_findings.summary: The S7 schema still does not mechanically link mastery_judgment.status="mastered" to supporting node_mastery_evidence (two arrays joined by node_id) and still requires load.current_model_version minimum:1, so it cannot encode a cold-start version 0; both remain rubric/contract-enforced rather than schema-enforced.
minor_findings.failure_scenario: No schema if/then couples a mastered judgment to its same-node multidimensional evidence, and current_model_version<1 is rejected by the integer minimum:1. These are not contract defects (the cross-array join is genuinely inexpressible in Draft 2020-12 and cold-start intentionally fails the input gate and routes to S4 with positive_artifact=null), but the schema-hardening opportunity flagged by MIN-04 remains open.
minor_findings.required_change: Optional only: keep the G7-rubric/route-based design (already documented) or, if desired, add a $id/$ref same-node anchor or a 0/sentinel for cold-start; not required for the contract to hold.

disagreements.assessment: Disagree with the major-severity conclusion and the claim that the benchmark fails to reconcile with canonical grading. The benchmark aggregates the canonical eval-* tree (eval-*/<config>/run-1), not the case-* historical tree; against the canonical tree every one of the 42 gradings reconciles exactly.
